scope: Synthetic supplied-label factory evidence and candidate coordinates only
coordinate_arithmetic: Check each scalar builtin integer input and every intermediate operation in signed int64 range before any bounds shortcut
padding: left,top,right,bottom nonnegative int64, sums checked int64 and strictly below padded scene dimensions
compatibility: Centre inside padded grid, Chebyshev radius2, circular unsigned8 difference at most1, surviving scene nodes only
outside_original: Diagnostic only; support in padding is allowed
outside_padded: Unsupported even with in-bounds neighboring nodes; retain full denominator

ordered_matching: Owned template samples in original chain order; complete scene topology; one scene chain per template chain; different template chains may reuse physical scene nodes
zero_owned_template_chains: Keep a complete zero contribution MatchResult
